name: One Week
source:
In a society where AIs are an important part of companies, there is one in particular that every year chooses five humans. Kate will be a candidate this year. Will she be chosen?

[From [url=https://mr-mentat.itch.io/one-week/]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在人工智能成为公司重要组成部分的社会中，每年都会选择五个人类。凯特今年将成为候选人。她会被选中吗？

[来自[url=https://mr-mentat.itch.io/one-week/]itch.io[/url]]
